nodes.name: Breakpoints & Visibility Utilities
nodes.summary: Defines the responsive breakpoint scale (xs/sm/md/lg/xl/2xl) and provides utility classes for show/hide at breakpoints, screen-reader-only (.sr-only), text truncation (.text-truncate), and two-line clamp (.line-clamp-2). Used globally across all pages to implement responsive layout behaviour.

nodes.name: Detail Page Shared Styles
nodes.summary: Shared CSS patterns for quotation, rental, and future entity detail pages. Covers the detail header/title row, summary cards grid, two-column info grid (collapses to one on mobile), internal-note callout with dark-mode overrides, section chrome, table cell helpers, decision badges (approved/rejected), and hover transitions on summary cards. Relies heavily on design tokens from tokens.css.

nodes.name: Marketplace Card UI Styles
nodes.summary: Chrome Web Store-inspired design layer for card-based module views. Defines .mp-card with hover-lift, .mp-grid (auto-fill responsive grid), KPI widget strip (.mp-kpi-strip / .mp-kpi-widget) with coloured accent bars, grid/list view toggle (.mp-view-toggle), section headers, dashboard chart panels (.mp-chart-grid), skeleton loading cards, empty state, hero banner with gradient, toolbar, and quick-stats row. Includes dark-mode overrides and responsive breakpoints at 420px, 640px, and 768px.

nodes.name: Shared Page Layout Styles
nodes.summary: Reusable page-level CSS used by CustomersPage, LeadsPage, and all future list modules. Covers page-header, toolbar with search/filter/date inputs, data-table (sortable headers, hover rows, empty and skeleton states), row action buttons, pagination controls, form layout grid (.form-row-2), value-prefix inputs, and error banners. Includes a responsive breakpoint at 640px that collapses two-column forms to one and hides non-essential toolbar elements.

nodes.name: CSS Design Tokens
nodes.summary: Foundational CSS custom-property file that defines the entire design token system: full colour palettes (primary blue, success green, warning amber, danger red, info cyan, purple, gray neutrals), semantic surface/border/text aliases, backward-compat colour aliases, layout dimensions (sidebar widths, topbar height, content max-width), border-radius scale, shadow scale (xs–xl), z-index scale, transition durations and easing, sidebar colours, badge/toast/error/JSON viewer semantic tokens, and a complete dark-theme override block under [data-theme="dark"]. Also includes a prefers-reduced-motion rule that disables all animations.
